1.web: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!
1.asv: Woe to her that is rebellious and polluted! to the oppressing city!

2.web: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in Yahweh. She didn’t draw near to her God.
2.asv: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in Jehovah; she drew not near to her God.

3.web: Her princes in the midst of her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
3.asv: Her princes in the midst of her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they leave nothing till the morrow.

4.web: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.
4.asv: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons; her priests have profaned the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.

5.web: Yahweh, in the midst of her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.
5.asv: Jehovah in the midst of her is righteous; he will not do iniquity; every morning doth he bring his justice to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.

6.web: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.
6.asv: I have cut off nations; their battlements are desolate; I have made their streets waste, so that none passeth by; their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.

7.web: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction, so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her.” But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.
7.asv: I said, Only fear thou me; receive correction; so her dwelling shall not be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her: but they rose early and corrupted all their doings.

8.web: “Therefore wait for me”, says Yahweh, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
8.asv: Therefore wait ye for me, saith Jehovah, until the day that I rise up to the prey; for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger; for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

9.web: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on Yahweh’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.
9.asv: For then will I turn to the peoples of a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of Jehovah, to serve him with one consent.

10.web: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.
10.asv: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.

11.web: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings, in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out of your midst your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be haughty in my holy mountain.
11.asv: In that day shalt thou not be put to shame for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me; for then I will take away out of the midst of thee thy proudly exulting ones, and thou shalt no more be haughty in my holy mountain.

12.web: But I will leave in your midst an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in Yahweh’s name.
12.asv: But I will leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall take refuge in the name of Jehovah.

13.web: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity, nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”
13.asv: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth; for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

14.web: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
14.asv: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.

15.web: Yahweh has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, Yahweh, is in your midst. You will not be afraid of evil any more.
15.asv: Jehovah hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the King of Israel, even Jehovah, is in the midst of thee; thou shalt not fear evil any more.

16.web: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”
16.asv: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not; O Zion, let not thy hands be slack.

17.web: Yahweh, your God, is in your midst, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
17.asv: Jehovah thy God is in the midst of thee, a mighty one who will save; he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love; he will joy over thee with singing.

18.web: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.
18.asv: I will gather them that sorrow for the solemn assembly, who were of thee; to whom the burden upon her was a reproach.

19.web: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you, and I will save those who are lame, and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.
19.asv: Behold, at that time I will deal with all them that afflict thee; and I will save that which is lame, and gather that which was driven away; and I will make them a praise and a name, whose shame hath been in all the earth.

20.web: At that time will I bring you in, and at that time will I gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says Yahweh.
20.asv: At that time will I bring you in, and at that time will I gather you; for I will make you a name and a praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I bring back your captivity before your eyes, saith Jehovah.
